hooks.command: IN=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; sid=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.session_id // "unknown"'); case "$f" in *.py) ruff check --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; perl -e 'alarm 45; exec @ARGV' pyright "$f" 2>/dev/null | tail -1;; esac; bash tools/review_hook.sh "$f" 2>&1 || true; (GITDIR=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null || echo '.git') && mkdir -p "${GITDIR}/claude-sessions" 2>/dev/null && echo "$f" >> "${GITDIR}/claude-sessions/${sid}-touched-files" 2>/dev/null) || true

IN=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*|*"git push"*) GL=$(command -v gitleaks 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$GL" ] || { [ -x /opt/homebrew/bin/gitleaks ] && GL=/opt/homebrew/bin/gitleaks; }; if [ -n "$GL" ]; then "$GL" protect --staged --redact --no-banner --config=.gitleaks.toml >&2 || { echo "BLOCKED: gitleaks found secrets in staged changes (above). False positive? .gitleaks.toml allowlist or a # gitleaks:allow comment." >&2; exit 2; }; else echo "gitleaks NOT FOUND - staged secret scan did NOT run (brew install gitleaks)" >&2; fi;; esac; exit 0

STAGED_PY=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM -- '*.py' 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$STAGED_PY" ] && command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff format --check --force-exclude $STAGED_PY >/tmp/mira-commit-format.log 2>&1 || echo 'heads up: staged Python file(s) are not ruff-formatted -- run: ruff format <file> (see /tmp/mira-commit-format.log)'; fi; exit 0

echo '--- MIRA v2.0 ---' && git log --oneline -5 && echo '--- Skills ---' && ls .claude/skills/*.md 2>/dev/null | xargs -I{} basename {} .md | tr '\n' ' ' && echo && echo '--- Effort ---' && echo "CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=${CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL:-default} (use /effort to change; xhigh recommended for engine.py / shared/inference work)"
